# AccountSuspension.com

> Independent account suspension case preparation for US account holders: diagnosis of platform notices, root cause analysis, Plans of Action, appeal preparation and held-funds release requests. Not affiliated with any platform. No guaranteed outcomes. Submissions go through each platform's official route from the client's own account.

- [What we will not do](https://accountsuspension.com/ethics/)

## Services
- [Suspension Case Review](https://accountsuspension.com/services/suspension-case-review/): A written diagnosis of your notice, the likely root cause and your realistic options.
- [Plan of Action Writing](https://accountsuspension.com/services/plan-of-action-writing/): Root cause, corrective actions and preventive measures, written for the reviewer who reads it.
- [Appeal Preparation and Submission Support](https://accountsuspension.com/services/appeal-preparation/): Social, content and ad account appeals written to the rule cited, submitted through your account.
- [Held Funds and Payouts](https://accountsuspension.com/services/held-funds-payouts/): Classify the hold, preserve the records and prepare the official disbursement request.
- [Identity and Business Verification Support](https://accountsuspension.com/services/identity-verification-support/): Get documents right the first time so verification stops blocking the account.
- [IP and Authenticity Complaint Response](https://accountsuspension.com/services/ip-complaint-response/): Trademark, copyright and counterfeit complaints: retractions, evidence and counter-notices.
- [Policy Compliance Audit](https://accountsuspension.com/services/policy-compliance-audit/): Find the problem before the platform does: listings, metrics, site and account structure.
- [Account Health Monitoring](https://accountsuspension.com/services/account-health-monitoring/): Regular review of account health, notices and metrics, with early warning notes.
- [Priority Case Review](https://accountsuspension.com/services/priority-case-review/): For deadlines on the notice, payroll at stake or a response window closing.

## Guides
- [How to write an Amazon Plan of Action that gets read](https://accountsuspension.com/blog/how-to-write-an-amazon-plan-of-action/): An Amazon Plan of Action has three parts: the root cause of the problem in your own operation, the corrective actions you have already completed, and the preventive measures that stop it happening again. It should be specific, short, factual and supported by documents Amazon can verify. Generic apologies and promises are the most common reason plans are rejected.
- [Amazon deactivated my account and is holding my funds: what now?](https://accountsuspension.com/blog/amazon-funds-held-after-deactivation/): When Amazon deactivates a seller account, it usually holds the balance while the appeal is open. If the account is reinstated, disbursements resume. If it is not, the remaining balance is handled under the Amazon Services Business Solutions Agreement, subject to refunds, chargebacks and any claims. Plan the appeal and the disbursement request together, because they depend on the same evidence.
- [PayPal permanent limitation and the 180-day hold explained](https://accountsuspension.com/blog/paypal-permanent-limitation-180-day-hold/): A permanent limitation means PayPal has decided to end the relationship. Under the PayPal User Agreement, PayPal may hold your balance, commonly for up to 180 days, to cover disputes, chargebacks and reversals. After the hold, the remaining balance is usually released, provided there are no outstanding liabilities and any requested information has been supplied.
- [Stripe closed my account: how to get held funds released](https://accountsuspension.com/blog/stripe-account-closed-funds-held/): When Stripe closes an account, it may pay out remaining funds on a schedule or hold them for a period to cover refunds and disputes, as set out in the Stripe Services Agreement and your notice. If the closure followed information Stripe could not verify, a review with the right documents can sometimes reverse it. If your business type is restricted, focus on an orderly release.
- [YouTube channel terminated: how the appeal really works](https://accountsuspension.com/blog/youtube-channel-terminated-appeal/): YouTube terminates channels after three Community Guidelines strikes within 90 days, for a single case of severe abuse, or after repeated copyright strikes. You can appeal a termination using the form linked from the notice. Appeals are limited, so the first submission should explain the context of the content cited, clearly and specifically.
- [Facebook account suspended: what to do in the first 24 hours](https://accountsuspension.com/blog/facebook-account-suspended-what-to-do/): Log in and follow the on-screen steps first. If the account was hacked, use Meta's hacked account recovery. Complete any identity or video selfie check promptly. Use the option to disagree with the decision within the window stated in the notice, commonly 180 days. Do not create a new account while the original is suspended.
- [Google AdSense disabled for invalid traffic: how to appeal](https://accountsuspension.com/blog/google-adsense-invalid-traffic-appeal/): Find the source of the invalid traffic in your analytics and server logs, remove it, and explain in the appeal what you found, what you changed and how you will monitor it. Appeals that say only that you did nothing wrong rarely succeed.
- [Google Merchant Center misrepresentation: what reviewers check](https://accountsuspension.com/blog/google-merchant-center-misrepresentation-fix/): Misrepresentation suspensions are about trust. Reviewers check whether your website clearly shows who you are, how to contact you, what customers pay, and how shipping and returns work, and whether your feed matches the site. Fix every gap before requesting a review, because repeated unsuccessful requests can trigger a waiting period.
- [Uber, Lyft, DoorDash or Instacart deactivation: how to appeal](https://accountsuspension.com/blog/gig-driver-deactivation-appeal/): Get the reason in writing, then match the route to it. For background checks, get a copy of the report and dispute errors with the screening company. For ratings, safety reports or fraud flags, gather trip or delivery records, photos and messages, and submit a factual appeal through the platform's official channel. Check whether your city or state has deactivation protections for app-based workers.
- [Held funds on Wise, Payoneer, Upwork and Fiverr: a practical guide](https://accountsuspension.com/blog/held-funds-wise-payoneer-upwork-fiverr/): Classify the hold first: a verification request, a compliance review, a dispute or an account closure. Each has different release conditions. Answer every request completely and consistently, keep a record of all correspondence, and make sure a bank account in your own name is available for the release.
- [Seven mistakes that turn a recoverable suspension into a permanent one](https://accountsuspension.com/blog/suspension-appeal-mistakes/): The mistakes that most often make a suspension permanent are opening a new account, submitting a rushed or generic appeal, sending documents that do not match the account, describing fixes you have not made, arguing with the reviewer, submitting repeated identical appeals, and paying someone who claims inside access.
- [eBay account suspended: what the notice means and what to do](https://accountsuspension.com/blog/ebay-account-suspended-what-it-means/): An eBay suspension blocks selling and sometimes buying, while a restriction limits what you can do. Read the notice for the policy area, check your seller performance, fix the underlying issue, and respond through the channel eBay names in the notice. Never open another account while suspended.
